title: PTC ThingWorx Thing
description: Schema for a PTC ThingWorx thing (digital twin instance), representing a connected industrial asset or device.

name.description: Unique thing name in the ThingWorx platform

thingTemplate.description: Parent thing template that defines property/service/event shape

thingShape.description: Applied thing shape for additional properties or services

tags.description: Model tag vocabulary entries for classification

isEnabled.description: Whether the thing is enabled and able to receive data

isSystemObject.description: True if this is a built-in ThingWorx system object

identifier.description: External identifier for mapping to physical device or asset

projectName.description: ThingWorx project the thing belongs to

examples.name: CNC_Machine_Line3_Station7
examples.description: CNC Machining Center - Production Line 3, Station 7
